[center][/center][center]﻿At the moment the mod is incomplete, I've got plans to add more things in the future!

[b]Gifts[/b]
Gunther's likes are still being chased, but at the moment he detests anything with eggs
[img]https://i.imgur.com/81pFkyF.png[/img]

[b]Gunther's routines
Mondays and Thursdays: [/b]At 8:30 AM Gunther goes to the museum,  2:00 PM reads a book and at  10:00 PM He goes sleep!

[b]Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Saturdays: [/b]At 8:30 AM Gunther goes to the museum,  2:00 PM he clean an artifact and at  10:00 PM He goes sleep!

[b]Fridays: [/b]At 8:30 AM Gunther goes to the museum,  2:00 PM he clean an artifact, 5:00 PM he goes to the saloon and at  10:00 PM He goes sleep![/center][center][b]Sundays: [/b]At 8:30 AM Gunther goes to the seedShop,  1:00 PM he goes to the beach see the sea, 5:00 PM he goes to the saloon and at  10:00 PM He goes sleep![img]https://i.imgur.com/wo4CC1A.png[/img][/center][center][b]Gunther's House[/b]
Now Gunther has a home for him!
